title: Aero 4's
texts: 4 sets x 4 reps using routes or circuits

The goal of this workout is to maintain an increased level of blood flow to the forearms without creating a high level of muscle pump until the final rep.

Choose 4 easy routes or circuits which are around 4 grades below your max on-sight level. Each rep should last between 1 and 3 minutes. This means each set should take between 4 and 12 minutes in total to complete. Ideally, each set would be completed on a different route or circuit but is fine to repeat a climb if necessary.

Aim to keep a consistent pace and avoid shaking out for too long on resting positions. The climb should be easy enough for you to focus on good technique throughout.
